author: reek
body: A chapter that grounds Device.Port may perform port I/O in its bodies without declaring the effect -- the internal hardware exemption, declared in the file instead of the compiler's hardcoded quire list. touch performs port-out-byte (a [Device.Port] intrinsic) while its own signature is pure and it is not in an exempt quire; without the grounds line this is CDX2031. The effectful let is legal here for the same reason -- a grounding chapter's bodies need no act-conversion.
